summary: Implemented the Tabs feature without running any code or tests (per instructions). Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (Tab, TabsRenderable, Tabs); UnderlineBar gained clickable_ranges (before width) and now yields one rich Text with click spans appended last; Opacity merges blended color into the existing style so metadata is kept. Added tests in tests/test_tabs.py plus appended cases in tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py and test_opacity.py, docs/reference/tabs.md, and sandbox/tabs_demo.py with tabs_demo.css. Deviations to review: the resolver was left unchanged because Edge already had size, fraction, and min_size; App has no focus method, so Escape's call is guarded with getattr; the bar position uses the displayed index of the active name, not the full-list index, so duplicates place the underline correctly; Tabs sets can_focus=True so it receives keys; letter search applies only to single-character keys. Nothing was committed, and the new tests have not been executed.
